specification_text: LATITUDE: GPS Latitude determined by PennDOT, Length 12, Constraints: DD MM:SS.ddd; LONGITUDE: GPS Longitude determined by PennDOT (in negative degrees), Length 12, Constraints: DD MM:SS.ddd
conversion_formula: decimal_degrees = degrees + minutes/60.0 + seconds/3600.0 (negated for longitude in Western hemisphere)
unresolved_caveats: 2,146 candidate paired records disagree with state route decimal coordinates by >500m (up to 48.47 km)
Local road crashes prior to 2008 frequently lack geocoded coordinates
Field-level operational selection policy between police DMS and state decimal coordinates remains gated pending site-level discrepancy review in Phase 3 Module B
